name: Megalosaurus
notes: Appeared during the Naraka portal event; killed Nirigili’s Elephantbird mount.
placement_note: Native to Naraka. It entered this realm through the portal Guyuk tore open over the Hyrkanian steppe and killed Nirigili's Elephantbird mount -- the event records both the beast spill and that loss (event_naraka_portal). Not ambient fauna: it is met at that crossing, not across the map.
